parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to detach all tags from the cluster. Valid values: **true** and **false**. Default value: **false**.

>  This parameter takes effect only if `TagKey.n` is empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **cluster**.
